ideas.text: Cache Keeper mod: reserve = measured cost per ping x pings needed until reset, with the user's tier table as the minimum.
Two-threshold safe stop: wrap-up line with a Status.md handoff note, then a hard floor that holds new prompts and edits.
Status line, band above the prompt, /cache on/off/status/reserve commands, a ping log pane, dry run and a toast on reset.
A Cache Keeper side pane with a usage timeline, reset countdown and full ping log.
Warnings when the weekly (7-day) window, not the 5h window, is the real limit.
A 'keep hot until' option for a set time instead of only an idle-hours cap.
Video and photo editing tools inside the hub, prototyped as local browser tools like Motion Studio.
Request form for other departments to fix late-information intake, the Director's named biggest blocker.
Consent and media-rights register with face blurring and metadata removal for beneficiary photos.
Toggle between Direction A and new identity by double-clicking the sidebar logo, persisted per browser.
Serve new identity fonts locally behind a single root-element switch after 0.3.1.1 token clean-up.
Evening (dark) mode for the new identity, with its own contrast table (task 0.3.4.3).
A QA component page showing every component state in both designs (task 0.3.2.3).
Aref Ruqaa accent word per page and IBM Plex Mono, installed once a screen uses them.
Add a phone and keyboard path for switching designs, since the logo double-click is desktop-only.
Show an «عاجل» mark in the prototype if the owner wants the Director to see it at the re-check.
Show the editor's name on each version («حرره محمد») in the prototype.
Command palette (Ctrl K) for the new design, only if the Director wants it.
Persist calendar move requests in the shared store so navigation does not drop them.
Make the phone approval sheet sit above the bottom bar before the user scrolls.
Keep prototype data in the browser across refresh, with a «إعادة ضبط السيناريو» reset button.
Single npm run qa command running all browser suites and tests together.
Draft the Version 1 Checkpoint 1.1 plan (Vercel and Supabase setup) for approval once the gate closes.
Add a change-password screen for signed-in users; today only the forgot-password email flow exists.
Move work items and approvals into Supabase so permissions are enforced on shared data.
Run the older QA scripts with a signed-in session once the owner has set passwords.

findings.text: percentUsed has one-decimal resolution and only updates on responses, so measuring cost per ping may be noisy or stale.
With a 5-minute cache, keeping it hot for hours likely costs more than rebuilding it. The mod needs a break-even check.
The 5h limit is account-wide. Several sessions running the mod would each claim the full reserve unless they share one record.
Unverified: whether $.model.fork reads refresh the main thread's 1-hour cache entry. If not, pings waste usage and the cache still expires.
The cost calibration counts other sessions' and subagents' usage, which can inflate the learned rate and over-reserve.
In the desktop app, a held prompt may not be put back into the input box, so the user may have to retype it.
Prototype has no scenario 'today'; dueSoon counts every item due by 23 Sep, so October testers see all work as late.
R01 contains answers in all seven role sections despite single-section branching; authorship of S3-S7 is unconfirmed.
globals.css hard-codes most colours outside six variables, blocking a clean identity switch until tokenised.
Phase 0.2.2 skip directive not yet logged in progress.md, which the project rules require for dated decisions.
Checkpoint 0.3 note still refers to participants testing frozen build 0.2.2.6, now skipped; text is stale.
The design toggle cannot be reached on phone widths or by keyboard, because the logo sits in the sidebar, which is hidden under 700px.
The .claude/ folder, including the new launch.json, is left untracked and uncommitted.
The phone approval sheet only sticks above the bottom bar after scrolling; on first load it partly sits under the navigation bar.
A pre-existing emoji in MVP_draft.md breaks the project's zero-emoji rule; it is still not removed.
Requested calendar moves live in the page's local state and are lost when the user navigates away.
Production alias comms-hub-three.vercel.app is public without authentication; prototype content is visible to anyone with the link.
Prototype state resets on page refresh, so the Director loses test progress if he reloads on Vercel.
ISO dates inside Arabic sentences display reversed (23-09-2026) due to missing direction isolation.
Design switch has no keyboard path; double-click or double-tap only.
Work data is per-browser mock state, so reducer role rules protect interface behaviour only, not shared data; real approval/publish enforcement needs the database.
A reviewer who submitted a work can approve it; nothing prevents self-approval and the spec does not forbid it.
email_status and request_access are callable anonymously, letting anyone test whether an email is an approved account (enumeration).
